title: Revive funkmoon as a typed Lua 5.5 functional toolkit
description: Modernize this dependency-free functional library around Lua 5.5.1 and LuaCATS generics while retaining its require name and declared Lua 5.2 through 5.5 runtime compatibility. The implementation covers deterministic dense-array semantics, corrected legacy helpers, nil-safe varargs, useful eager/lazy combinators, LuaRocks metadata, and accurate user docs. Design contract: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-16-typed-functional-toolkit-design.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Public API and runtime scope are implemented and documented
- [ ] Existing module name and established call forms remain usable
- [ ] Runtime/type verification follow-up is tracked

title: Specify Lua runtime and typed collection contract
description: Record the compatibility and API decisions that all implementation work follows: Lua 5.5.1 is primary; runtime support is declared for Lua 5.2 through 5.5; LuaCATS annotations provide LuaLS generics without runtime dependencies; sequence functions operate on dense 1-based arrays in order; legacy module name and call forms are retained. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-16-typed-functional-toolkit-design.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Design note names the supported runtime and type tooling
- [x] Sequence and compatibility semantics are explicit

title: Modernize typed collection, function, and iterator APIs
description:
Update funkmoon.lua with LuaCATS generic annotations across all public functions and FunctionalTable methods. Define list APIs over dense arrays in ascending index order; preserve filter/filterNot/takeWhile/dropWhile predicate behavior while removing unspecified pairs-order dependence; make distinct retain first occurrence and have groupBy call its key function once. Preserve nil arity in partial, partialLast, and stream, plus apply when explicit 
 arity is supplied. Add eager helpers (head, last, take, drop, count, each, sum, concat, findValue), function combinators (identity, constant, compose, pipe, tap), and lazy iterator map/filter/take/zip helpers. Preserve require funkmoon, old names and return shapes where practical, and Lua 5.2 through 5.5 compatibility.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Public API exposes documented generic callback and return types
- [x] Sequence traversal is deterministic and the listed legacy defects are corrected
- [x] Nil-containing argument/return tuples survive when explicit arity is available
- [x] New helpers are available standalone and sequence methods are wired into FunctionalTable
close_reason: Modernized the typed core API, fixed sequence ordering and nil-arity handling, and added eager/lazy/function combinators; runtime/type verification is tracked in funkmoon-f2g.5.

title: Add LuaRocks metadata for Lua 5.2–5.5
description: Add a versioned rockspec for the existing root module, project source, MIT license, and no external runtime dependencies. Declare Lua 5.2 through 5.5 compatibility, keep require funkmoon unchanged, and document a release tag/source convention without publishing.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] LuaRocks can resolve the funkmoon module from the rockspec
- [x] Supported Lua range and license metadata are accurate
- [x] No runtime dependencies are introduced
close_reason: Added the Lua 5.2–5.5 rockspec for funkmoon 0.13.0-1 with no external runtime dependencies.

title: Rewrite onboarding and API documentation for typed Lua users
description: Replace stale README examples with accurate Lua 5.5.1 setup and usage. Explain LuaCATS/LuaLS editor support and its distinction from runtime typing, document declared Lua 5.2 through 5.5 compatibility and dense-array semantics, show standalone and method pipelines, cover the full legacy and new API, provide LuaRocks install guidance, and include contribution/release notes.
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Documented names and examples match the implementation
- [x] Installation, type tooling, compatibility, and collection semantics are clear
- [x] Stale dropWhile, stream, and missing-module examples are removed
close_reason: Rewrote README for Lua 5.5.1 and 5.2+ with LuaCATS/LuaLS typing, installation, sequence contract, legacy API behavior, and accurate examples

title: Add regression, LuaLS, and runtime compatibility verification
description: After core API changes, add focused regression cases for sequence ordering, filterNot/dropWhile ordering, stable distinct, single-call groupBy and invalid nil/NaN keys, flattenDeep cycle detection, and nil-preserving variadic behavior. Add type-check examples for generic transformations, FunctionalTable chains, max/min input constraints, and compose/pipe overloads. Configure supported-runtime coverage across Lua 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, and 5.5. This is a tracked verification follow-up.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Regression suite covers repaired semantics and nil arity
- [ ] LuaLS examples verify type propagation
- [ ] Automated runtime coverage includes Lua 5.2 through 5.5
